name: Altamaha Regional Park
evidence: Esri 0.26 m/px at 31.4274,-81.6072: rows sit behind a sandy road and ~40-50 m tree band west of the river; basin edge is ramp lot, road and pavilion (used strip); nearest RV ~36 m through trees by the dock. County 'Riverfront Full Hook-Up Sites' is marketing, no per-site map found.

name: Barrington County Park
evidence: Wayback 43291 0.255 m/px at 31.4715,-81.608: gravel spurs run toward the oxbow (Harpers Lake) and two tan clearings near the bank, but no RV or pad is identifiable at them; most of the bank has a shrub/tree fringe, south row ~23-28 m back. Firefly has no water class, no per-site map; default down.

name: Clay Hill Campground
evidence: Esri and Wayback 2018/2024 frames: pine canopy on the peninsula; tan patches ~12-25 m from shore behind a tree band near 33.6682,-82.4385 and 33.6665,-82.4385, none confirmable as an RV pad. Operator 'all right on the water' is a lead; Firefly 'RV Site - Water Access' class seen but its unit map is behind reCAPTCHA; default down.

name: Georgia Mountain Fairgrounds Campground
evidence: Esri leaf-off 0.128 m/px at 34.97135,-83.7718: Area II east lobe, paved back-in spurs with pads on the lake side of the loop road, ~15-20 m from the Chatuge riprap across open unused grass, road behind them. Official 2025 map places C-series loops on this shore; rate page sells RV 'Lakeside' nightly in Area II.

name: Chattahoochee Old Town Park
evidence: West Point Lake, not Wedowee. Wayback 2014 and 43291 z19 at 33.205,-85.085: gravel circle loop on the west point, rim ~10-20 m from high water over open ground, but no site map, so rim pads are not proven RV sites; RV in frame at ~33.2055,-85.0848 ~30 m from high water past a tree clump. Open view earned, lakefront not. East road has a 40+ m tree band.

name: Jacks River Fields Campground
evidence: rec.gov 10249178 per-site coords against NHD: 004 4 m, 005 8 m, 006 15 m from South Fork Jacks River (007 25 m); Wayback 2019 leaf-off 0.245 m/px shows open corridor, no continuous buffer, channel itself unseen. FS: 'on the bank', parking spurs. No rec.gov shoreline flag; creekside for stream size.

name: Low Gap Campground
evidence: rec.gov 10309348 coords vs NHD: 23-ft-eligible site 4 21 m, 3 27 m, 2 31 m (limits 24 ft; 8 at 39 m); 'Creek Access' on 12 of 13 sites is not discriminating; creek 'flows through' per rec.gov. Canopy: creek unseen, so creekside not earned, default down. Pin moved ~280 m to the loop.

name: Lakeside RV Camps
evidence: Esri and Wayback at 32.3560,-82.1625: clearing with gravel tracks south of a ~270 m farm-scale pond, no legible RV pads or RVs; pin sits on a house. Operator 'site 8, 20 feet away' is a lead only; 2022 gallery photo shows 50+ m of tall grass and a brush row to the water. RV sites not located, so no pin move.
